classification.difficultyReason: Construct an auxiliary parallel and combine transferred angles with straight-line angles.

content.prompt: Lines $AB$ and $CD$ are parallel in each of the diagrams below. Construct an auxiliary line to help find $\theta$.

spec.description: Two horizontal parallel lines and a broken transversal bending to the right. Parallel marks point right. All original point names and angle labels are retained.
spec.mathematics: The upper obtuse angle is 150 degrees, the lower acute angle is 75 degrees, and theta is the angle opening left at the bend.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and theta are visible.

answer.short:
$105^\circ$.

Draw a parallel through the bend; add $30^\circ$ and $75^\circ$.
answer.worked:
Draw a horizontal auxiliary line through the bend, parallel to $AB$ and $CD$. The acute angle at the upper crossing is $180^\circ-150^\circ=30^\circ$ (angles on a straight line). Alternate angles transfer $30^\circ$ and $75^\circ$ to the bend.

$$\begin{align*}\theta&=30^\circ+75^\circ\\\theta&=105^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Complete solution figure with a dashed auxiliary parallel through the bend.
spec.mathematics: The two left-facing sectors at the bend are 30 degrees and 75 degrees.

spec.description: Broken transversal bends left between horizontal parallels. Theta is above the upper line on the left of its crossing.
spec.mathematics: The bend opens right through 120 degrees. The lower crossing has a 45-degree angle below the line on the right.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and theta are visible.

answer.short:
$105^\circ$.

The upper sloping segment makes $75^\circ$ with the auxiliary parallel.
answer.worked:
Draw a horizontal auxiliary line through the bend, parallel to $AB$ and $CD$. Corresponding angles give $45^\circ$ between its rightward ray and the lower sloping segment. Hence the angle between its rightward ray and the upper sloping segment is $120^\circ-45^\circ=75^\circ$. The corresponding acute angle at the upper crossing is also $75^\circ$.

$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^\circ-75^\circ\\\theta&=105^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line.

spec.description: Complete solution figure with the 120-degree bend split by a dashed auxiliary parallel.
spec.mathematics: The bend splits into 75 degrees above the auxiliary and 45 degrees below it; theta is 105 degrees.

spec.description: Broken transversal bends left between horizontal parallels; theta is below the lower line on the left of its crossing.
spec.mathematics: The upper-left angle at the upper crossing is 125 degrees and the right-facing bend is 115 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and theta are visible.

answer.short:
$120^\circ$.

The auxiliary parallel splits the bend into $55^\circ$ and $60^\circ$.
answer.worked:
Draw a horizontal auxiliary line through the bend, parallel to $AB$ and $CD$. The acute angle at the upper crossing is $180^\circ-125^\circ=55^\circ$ (angles on a straight line). Corresponding angles transfer $55^\circ$ to the upper side of the bend. Its lower sector is $115^\circ-55^\circ=60^\circ$. Corresponding angles give a $60^\circ$ angle below $AB$ on the right.

$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^\circ-60^\circ\\\theta&=120^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line.

spec.description: Complete solution figure with a dashed auxiliary parallel splitting the bend.
spec.mathematics: The bend splits into 55 degrees and 60 degrees; theta is supplementary to 60 degrees.

classification.difficultyReason: Two auxiliary parallels connect several bends; part b also requires interpreting a reflex angle.

content.prompt: Find the value of $\theta$ in each of the diagrams below by first adding two auxiliary lines:

spec.description: Descending zigzag joining two leftward horizontal parallel rays; both internal bends and all supplied angles are retained.
spec.mathematics: Top junction 120 degrees, first bend 100 degrees, second bend theta, bottom junction 35 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and theta are visible.

answer.short:
$75^\circ$.

Two auxiliary parallels give $60^\circ$, then $40^\circ$; add $35^\circ$.
answer.worked:
Draw a horizontal auxiliary line through each internal bend, parallel to the two given rays. The first sloping segment makes $180^\circ-120^\circ=60^\circ$ with a horizontal line (angles on a straight line). Alternate angles transfer $60^\circ$ to the upper sector of the $100^\circ$ bend. Its lower sector is $100^\circ-60^\circ=40^\circ$. Alternate angles transfer $40^\circ$ to the upper sector at the next bend and $35^\circ$ to its lower sector.

$$\begin{align*}\theta&=40^\circ+35^\circ\\\theta&=75^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Complete zigzag with dashed horizontal auxiliary lines through both internal bends.
spec.mathematics: The first bend splits into 60 and 40 degrees; the second splits into 40 and 35 degrees.

spec.description: Descending zigzag between rightward horizontal parallel rays carrying leftward parallel marks. The 240-degree label is outside the left bend.
spec.mathematics: Top junction 110 degrees, reflex angle at the first bend 240 degrees, interior angle at the next bend 95 degrees, bottom junction theta.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and theta are visible.

answer.short:
$45^\circ$.

The reflex angle leaves $120^\circ$ inside the first bend; auxiliary parallels give $70^\circ$ and $50^\circ$.
answer.worked:
Draw a horizontal auxiliary line through each internal bend, parallel to the two given rays. The first sloping segment makes $180^\circ-110^\circ=70^\circ$ with a horizontal line (angles on a straight line). The non-reflex angle at the first bend is $360^\circ-240^\circ=120^\circ$ (angles at a point). Alternate angles transfer $70^\circ$ to its upper sector, so its lower sector is $120^\circ-70^\circ=50^\circ$. Alternate angles transfer $50^\circ$ to the upper sector of the $95^\circ$ bend. Its lower sector is $95^\circ-50^\circ=45^\circ$. Alternate angles transfer this angle to the bottom junction.

$$\theta=45^\circ.$$

spec.description: Complete zigzag with dashed auxiliary parallels through both bends and transferred sector labels.
spec.mathematics: The first interior bend splits into 70 and 50 degrees; the second into 50 and 45 degrees; theta is 45 degrees.
